blurb: If you've got a wedding coming up or someone close to you does, Jhoanna at After the Yes Bridal Alterations is worth knowing about. She runs a one-woman operation out of Lewisville that has quietly built a five-star reputation on the kind of work that makes brides cry happy tears instead of the other kind. The reviews are consistent: she listens, she's patient, and she actually gets it done right. One bride came in with a strapless gown and wanted to add coverage over her arms. Jhoanna figured it out and nailed it. Another wrote that her day was perfect specifically because of what Jhoanna did with her dress. That's not a small thing. Wedding alterations are high stakes. The dress has to fit the moment, not just the body. Jhoanna seems to understand that. Formerly known as Metamorphosis of Gowns, she's been doing this long enough to have earned a loyal following and a reputation that gets passed around by word of mouth. If someone you know is dress shopping, this is the kind of referral that actually means something.
address: 114 N Poydras St, Lewisville, TX 75057, USA
